subject: Rename redisDb to serverDb (#156)
reason: The change is a mechanical rename of the internal typedef redisDb to serverDb across the source tree. Every changed line in the diff touches only that identifier (type declarations, function prototypes, local variables); no function body logic, struct field, config, command, reply, or on-wire/on-disk format is altered, and the type is not exposed through the module API. It is a compile-time refactor with no observable behavior change, so no scenario can distinguish the two builds and none is needed.
